Severn is the Guildhall bartender in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate.
“
Before you ask, I ain't got none o' that plum prosecco. Now, what can I get you, newcomer?
„
— Severn, really wishes people would stop ordering prosecco

Involvement

Act Three

He can be found in the Guildhall during Act 3, where he sells various alcoholic beverages and drugs. While some drugs can be found in areas around Baldur's Gate or looted off the corpses, Severn is the only trader that regularly sells and restocks them.

Break-up with Cheeky Nora

If  Oskar Fevras was not saved from  Brem in Act One,  Cheeky Nora can be found in the Guildhall. Speaking with her reveals that she had a relationship with Severn, that he broke if off (claiming  Nine-Fingers Keene "forbade our love"), that Nora is somewhat in denial, and that she is eager to win him back. She asks the party to discover why Severn ended their relationship, as she believes his explanation to be pretextual.

If asked, Severn tells the party that he is not interested in Nora's sexual proclivities, insinuating that her interest in him was fetishistic. He says specifically that Nora is a "M. F. - the M stands for Monster. Let's just say I ain't that type." The party can attempt to convince Nora to move on after which she rewards the party with a  Peridot Ring.
